sw.B: Kwa hiyo utatoa zawadi za kuaga \q kwa Moresheth-gathi. \q Nyumba za Akzibu zitakuwa udanganyifu \q kwa wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo utapaswa kuuaga Moresheth-gathi \q na kuupa zawadi za kuagana, kama baba anavyompa binti yake anayeolewa na kuondoka nyumbani. \q Akzibu, Mji wa Uongo, \q utawaangusha wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vì vậy ngươi sẽ trao quà tiễn biệt \q cho Mô-rê-sết-Gát; \q các nhà của Ạc-xíp [sẽ là] sự lừa dối \q cho các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vì thế ngươi sẽ tặng quà chia tay \q cho Mô-rê-sết-Gát. \q Các nhà của Ạc-xíp sẽ thành sự lừa dối \q cho các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vì vậy các ngươi phải từ biệt Mô-rê-sết-Gát \q và tặng nó quà tiễn biệt, như người cha tặng quà cho con gái đi lấy chồng xa nhà. \q Ạc-xíp, Thành Dối Trá, \q sẽ làm các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên thất vọng.

ko.L: 그러므로 너는 작별 선물을 줄 것이다, \q 모레셋가드에게. \q 악십의 집들은 속임수가 [될 것이다], \q 이스라엘 왕들에게.
ko.B: 그러므로 너는 작별 선물을 주어 \q 모레셋가드를 떠나보낼 것이다. \q 악십의 집들은 속임수로 드러날 것이다, \q 이스라엘 왕들에게.
ko.R: 그러므로 너는 모레셋가드와 작별하고, \q 딸을 시집보내는 아버지처럼 그 성에 작별 선물을 주어야 한다. \q '거짓 마을' 악십은 \q 이스라엘 왕들을 실망시킬 것이다.

decisions.choice: parting gifts to Moresheth-gath: a farewell, with a play on the word for a bride
decisions.reason: The word for parting gifts is used of the dowry a father gave his daughter when she married and left home (1 Kings 9:16). The name Moresheth sounds like the word for "betrothed". Judah must give up Micah's home town as a father sends away his daughter: it will be lost to the enemy. "You" is a woman, Zion or Judah.

decisions.choice: Achzib ... a deception: the name sounds like the word for a stream that dries up
decisions.reason: The name Achzib sounds like a word for a deceptive brook, a stream that runs dry in summer when travelers count on it (Jeremiah 15:18). The town will fail the kings who rely on it. This Achzib is in the low hills of Judah (Joshua 15:44), not the coastal town of the same name in the north.

decisions.choice: the kings of Israel: the kings of God's people, here the kings of Judah
decisions.reason: These towns belonged to Judah, so "Israel" here is the name of the whole people of God, whose kings now reign in Jerusalem. Micah uses the name this way again (3:1, 9).

decisions.choice: say goodbye ... as a father does for a daughter who marries and leaves home; the Town of Lies; let ... down (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the parting gifts (m1) and gives the sense of Achzib's name (m2), since the wordplay cannot be heard otherwise.

source.text: עֹ֗ד הַיֹּרֵשׁ֙ אָ֣בִי לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה עַד־עֲדֻּלָּ֥םיָב֖וֹא כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Again the possessor I will bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah; to Adullam will come [the] glory of Israel.

en.L: I will yet bring the one who takes possession to you, \q inhabitant of Mareshah; \q the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
en.B: I will once more bring a conqueror against you, \q people of Mareshah. \q The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
en.R: People of Mareshah, whose name sounds like "conqueror", \q I will bring a conqueror against you. \q Those who are the glory of Israel will run to Adullam to hide.

es.L: Aún traeré sobre ti al que toma posesión, \q tú que habitas en Maresa; \q hasta Adulam llegará la gloria de Israel.
es.B: Otra vez traeré contra ti a un conquistador, \q gente de Maresa. \q La gloria de Israel llegará hasta Adulam.
es.R: Gente de Maresa, cuyo nombre en hebreo suena como «conquistador», \q traeré contra ti a un conquistador. \q Los que son la gloria de Israel huirán a Adulam para esconderse.

fr.L: Je t’amènerai encore celui qui prend possession, \q habitante de Marésha ; \q jusqu’à Adoullam viendra la gloire d’Israël.
fr.B: Je ferai encore venir un conquérant contre toi, \q population de Marésha. \q La gloire d’Israël s’en ira jusqu’à Adoullam.
fr.R: Marésha, ton nom ressemble au mot « conquérant » : \q je ferai venir un conquérant contre toi. \q Ceux qui font la gloire d’Israël s’enfuiront à Adoullam pour s’y cacher.

sw.L: Bado nitakuletea yule amilikiye, \q ewe mkaaji wa Maresha; \q utukufu wa Israeli utakuja hadi Adulamu.
sw.B: Nitaleta tena mshindi dhidi yenu, \q enyi watu wa Maresha. \q Utukufu wa Israeli utafika Adulamu.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Maresha, ambao jina lenu linasikika kama "mshindi", \q nitaleta mshindi dhidi yenu. \q Wale walio utukufu wa Israeli watakimbilia Adulamu kujificha.

vi.L: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại đem kẻ chiếm đoạt đến cho ngươi, \q hỡi dân cư Ma-rê-sa; \q vinh quang của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ đến A-đu-lam.
vi.B: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại đem một kẻ chinh phục đến đánh ngươi, \q hỡi dân Ma-rê-sa. \q Vinh quang của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ phải đến A-đu-lam.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Ma-rê-sa, tên các ngươi nghe giống như "kẻ chinh phục", \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem một kẻ chinh phục đến đánh các ngươi. \q Những người là vinh quang của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ chạy đến A-đu-lam để ẩn náu.

ko.L: 내가 다시 차지할 자를 너에게 데려오겠다, \q 마레사의 주민아. \q 이스라엘의 영광이 아둘람까지 올 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 다시 정복자를 데려와 너를 치게 하겠다, \q 마레사 주민아. \q 이스라엘의 영광이 아둘람으로 갈 것이다.
ko.R: '정복자'라는 말과 소리가 비슷한 마레사 사람들아, \q 내가 정복자를 데려와 너희를 치게 하겠다. \q 이스라엘의 영광인 지도자들이 숨으려고 아둘람으로 도망칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: the one who takes possession ... Mareshah: a play on sound
decisions.reason: The word for one who takes possession, an heir or a conqueror, sounds like the name Mareshah. The town will be taken over by a new owner. "Again" may mean that, as before, an enemy will come, or simply "yet", still to come.

decisions.choice: the glory of Israel will come to Adullam: Israel's leaders will flee to hide in the caves
alternatives: Israel's God, its glory, will leave
Israel's wealth will be carried off
decisions.reason: Adullam was where David hid in a cave when he fled from Saul (1 Samuel 22:1). "The glory of Israel" most likely means its nobles and leaders, as "its glory" does in Isaiah 5:13. They will end up in hiding as David did. Some take "glory" to be Israel's God or its wealth.

decisions.choice: whose name sounds like "conqueror"; Those who are the glory of Israel will run to Adullam to hide (R)
decisions.reason: Readable lets the wordplay be heard (m1) and says what coming to Adullam means (m2).

decisions.choice: "cuyo nombre en hebreo suena como «conquistador»" (R)
decisions.reason: The pun works only in Hebrew, so Readable says so, as the Spanish term sheet sets for the pun of Amos 8:2 R.

source.text: קָרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י גָל֖וּ מִמֵּֽךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Make yourself bald and shave on account of [the] children of your delights; make wide your baldness like the eagle, for they have gone into exile from you.

en.L: Make yourself bald and cut off [your hair] \q for the children you delight in; \q make your baldness wide like the vulture's, \q for they have gone from you into exile.
en.B: Shave your head in mourning \q for the children you delight in. \q Make yourself as bald as the vulture, \q for they will be taken from you into exile.
en.R: Shave your heads to show your grief \q for the children you love. \q Make yourselves as bald as a vulture, \q because your children will be taken away as prisoners to another land.

es.L: Rápate y córtate [el cabello] \q por los hijos de tus delicias; \q ensancha tu calvicie como la del buitre, \q porque han ido al destierro lejos de ti.
es.B: Rápate la cabeza en señal de duelo \q por los hijos que tanto amas. \q Quédate calva como el buitre, \q porque te los llevarán al destierro.
es.R: Rápate la cabeza para mostrar tu dolor \q por los hijos que amas. \q Quédate tan calva como un buitre, \q porque tus hijos serán llevados presos a otra tierra.

fr.L: Rends-toi chauve et rase-[toi] \q pour les enfants de tes délices ; \q élargis ta calvitie comme le vautour, \q car ils sont partis loin de toi en exil.
fr.B: Rase-toi la tête en signe de deuil \q pour les enfants qui font tes délices. \q Rends-toi chauve comme le vautour, \q car ils seront emmenés loin de toi en exil.
fr.R: Rase-toi la tête pour montrer ta tristesse \q à cause des enfants que tu aimes. \q Rends-toi chauve comme un vautour, \q car tes enfants seront emmenés comme prisonniers dans un autre pays.

sw.L: Jinyoe upara na ukate [nywele zako] \q kwa ajili ya watoto unaowafurahia; \q panua upara wako kama wa tumbusi, \q kwa maana wamekwenda uhamishoni kutoka kwako.
sw.B: Nyoa kichwa chako kwa maombolezo \q kwa ajili ya watoto unaowapenda. \q Jifanye upara kama tumbusi, \q kwa maana watachukuliwa kutoka kwako kwenda uhamishoni.
sw.R: Nyoeni vichwa vyenu kuonyesha huzuni yenu \q kwa ajili ya watoto mnaowapenda. \q Jifanyeni vipara kama tumbusi, \q kwa sababu watoto wenu watachukuliwa mateka kwenda nchi nyingine.

vi.L: Hãy cạo đầu và cắt [tóc] \q vì những đứa con ngươi yêu dấu; \q hãy làm cho chỗ hói của ngươi rộng ra như chim kên kên, \q vì chúng đã bị lưu đày khỏi ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy cạo đầu để tang \q vì những đứa con ngươi yêu dấu. \q Hãy làm cho mình trọc đầu như chim kên kên, \q vì chúng sẽ bị bắt đi lưu đày khỏi ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy cạo đầu để tỏ nỗi đau buồn \q vì những đứa con các ngươi thương yêu. \q Hãy làm cho mình trọc như chim kên kên, \q vì con cái các ngươi sẽ bị bắt làm tù binh, đem đến một xứ khác.

ko.L: 너는 머리를 밀고 [머리털을] 깎아라, \q 네가 기뻐하는 자녀들 때문에. \q 대머리독수리처럼 네 대머리를 넓혀라. \q 그들이 너를 떠나 포로로 끌려갔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 슬퍼하며 머리를 밀어라, \q 네가 사랑하는 자녀들 때문에. \q 대머리독수리처럼 머리를 밀어라. \q 그들이 너에게서 포로로 끌려갈 것이다.
ko.R: 머리를 밀어 슬픔을 나타내어라, \q 너희가 사랑하는 자녀들 때문에. \q 대머리독수리처럼 머리를 완전히 밀어라. \q 너희 자녀들이 포로가 되어 다른 나라로 끌려갈 것이다.

decisions.choice: make yourself bald: shaving the head as a sign of mourning
decisions.reason: In mourning people shaved their heads or cut off their hair (Isaiah 15:2; Jeremiah 16:6; Amos 8:10), though the law forbade Israel to do it for the dead (Deuteronomy 14:1). The command is spoken to a woman, Zion or Judah as a mother, whose children are her people.

decisions.choice: the vulture: the bird usually called eagle, here the bald-headed vulture
decisions.reason: The word is the usual word for the eagle, but it also covers the great vultures. Here it is the griffon vulture, whose head and neck have only a little white down and look bald.

decisions.choice: they have gone into exile: a coming event spoken of as already done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed action. Prophets often speak of what God has decided as if it had already happened, so certain is it. The exile is still to come.

decisions.choice: vulture (L, B, R); they have gone (L); they will be taken (B, R); Shave your heads (R)
decisions.reason: All three levels say "vulture" (m2), since an eagle is not bald. Balanced and Readable put the exile in the future (m3). Readable speaks to the people as "you" plural, since the mother addressed stands for them.

decisions.choice: singular feminine address: "Rápate", "Quédate calva" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to the land as one woman; Spanish keeps the singular feminine at every level, where the English Readable turns to the plural.
